import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] lsc = new long[62], rsc = new long[62], rsc2 = new long[62];
    static char[] s;
    static Map<Pair, Long> nm = new HashMap<>(), mm = new HashMap<>();
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;

        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return first == pair.first && second == pair.second;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            res = res * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int R = sc.nextInt();
        int C = sc.nextInt();
        int total = 2 * (R + C);
        s = sc.next().toCharArray();

        lsc[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int index = 2 * R; index < total; index++) {
            lsc[index] = lsc[index - 1] * index / (index - 2 * R + 1);
        }
        for (int index = 0; index <= total; index++) {
            rsc[index] = comb(index, R);
            rsc2[index] = comb(index, R - 1);
        }

        long halfSum = rsc[total / 2] * rsc[total / 2];

        long totalSum = 0;
        int aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
        for (int index = total - 1; index >= 0; index--) {
            int condition;
            if (totalSum > 0) condition = 1; else condition = 0;
            if (bCount == total / 2) condition = 1;
            if (aCount == total / 2) condition = 0;
            if (condition != 0) {
                aCount++;
                totalSum -= rsc2[total / 2 - aCount] * rsc[total / 2 - bCount];
            } else {
                bCount++;
                totalSum += rsc2[total / 2 - bCount] * rsc[total / 2 - aCount];
            }
        }
        totalSum = Math.max(totalSum, -totalSum);

        mm.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int index = total - 1; index >= 2 * R - 1; index--) {
            nm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mm.entrySet()) {
                long sumVal = entry.getKey().first;
                long countVal = entry.getValue();
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                int aIdx = total / 2 - cnt;
                int bIdx = index + 1 - aIdx;
                long aSumVal = sumVal + rsc2[aIdx - 1] * rsc[bIdx];
                long bSumVal = sumVal - rsc2[bIdx - 1] * rsc[aIdx];

                if (s[index] == 'A') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L) + countVal);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L));
                } else if (s[index] == 'B') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L));
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L) + countVal);
                } else {
                    nm.put(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(aSumVal, cnt + 1), 0L) + countVal);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bSumVal, cnt), 0L) + countVal);
                }
            }
            totalSum -= lsc[index];
            mm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : nm.entrySet()) {
                long sumVal = it.getKey().first;
                long ncnt = it.getValue();
                int cnt = it.getKey().second;
                int aIdx = total / 2 - cnt;
                int bIdx = index - aIdx;
                if (cnt > total / 2 || total - index - cnt > total / 2) continue;
                long minVal = -halfSum - rsc[aIdx] * rsc[bIdx];
                long maxVal = halfSum + rsc[aIdx] * rsc[bIdx];
                if (sumVal < minVal || sumVal > maxVal) continue;
                Pair key = new Pair(sumVal, cnt);
                mm.put(key, mm.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + ncnt);
            }
        }

        long bSum = (long)1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
            long val = it.getKey().first;
            bSum = Math.min(bSum, Math.max(val, -val));
        }

        long totalAnswer = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sumVal = it.getKey().first;
            long ncnt = it.getValue();
            int cnt = it.getKey().second;
            if (sumVal == bSum || sumVal == -bSum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int index = 0; index < 2 * R - 1; index++) {
                    if (s[index] == '?') sem++;
                    else if (s[index] == 'A') cnt++;
                }
                long ways = comb(sem, total / 2 - cnt);
                totalAnswer += ncnt * ways;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(totalAnswer);
    }
}
